bio.text: Wes Climer, a Republican from York County, is a South Carolina state senator for District 15 and the Republican nominee for South Carolina's 5th Congressional District in 2026.

According to his legislative biography, Climer was born in Charlotte in 1982, earned a bachelor's degree from Furman University in 2006, and chairs the Senate Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee.
According to the same biography, he is married and has five children.

sources.title: Governor, Attorney General and Agriculture Commissioner Republican Primaries Head to June Runoffs as Climer and Dittmer Set Up Congressional Fight
